Remark
[General-codimension Gauss and Codazzi equations]

Source: petersen:page-0122 ↗ thm:pet-ch3-tangential-curvature-equation

1. ch3:3.4.11For $X,Y,Z$ tangent to $M$ (a submanifold with second fundamental form $T$ and normal connection $ abla ^\perp $), show \[ ar R(X,Y)Z=R^M(X,Y)Z+T_XT_YZ-T_YT_XZ+( abla ^\perp _XT)_YZ-( abla ^\perp _YT)_XZ, \] where $ ar R$ is the curvature of the ambient manifold and $( abla ^\perp _XT)_YZ= abla ^\perp _X(T_YZ)-T_{ abla ^M_XY}Z-T_Y abla ^M_XZ$; the tangential parts recover the Gauss equations, the normal parts the Peterson--Codazzi--Mainardi equations. (The source prints $R^M$ on both sides; the left-hand curvature is the ambient one $ ar R$, not the induced $R^M$.)
